label: Mood
description: The emotional temperature of the image.

items.name: serene
items.text: serene, still and quietly balanced, unhurried calm

items.name: melancholic
items.text: melancholic and wistful, a gentle ache of things passing

items.name: nostalgic
items.text: warmly nostalgic, like a memory slightly softened at the edges

items.name: tense
items.text: taut and suspenseful, something about to happen

items.name: ominous
items.text: ominous and foreboding, a quiet weight of dread

items.name: euphoric
items.text: euphoric and weightless, bursting bright energy

items.name: triumphant
items.text: triumphant and monumental, chest-out heroic grandeur

items.name: intimate
items.text: intimate and hushed, a private moment the viewer almost intrudes on

items.name: mysterious
items.text: mysterious and withholding, more implied than shown

items.name: desolate
items.text: desolate and abandoned, emptiness pressing in

items.name: dreamlike
items.text: dreamlike and untethered, logic softened into reverie
